title: Aura Chat — Real-Time Messaging
description: Full-stack real-time chat application with authentication, direct messaging, groups, typing indicators, online presence, notifications, media uploads, Web Push, and optional AI features.

caseStudy.problem: People need fast, expressive communication with presence and group workflows in one place.
caseStudy.role: Designed and implemented the full-stack messaging experience, including real-time events, authentication, media, and notifications.
highlights: Direct and group messaging with Socket.io
Typing, presence, read state, and Web Push
JWT authentication with uploads and optional AI assistance
caseStudy.result: A deployable real-time communication product demonstrating event-driven full-stack architecture.

title: SAAD & CO Bank — Digital Banking
description: Production-oriented simulated banking platform with accounts, transfers, double-entry ledger records, savings goals, beneficiaries, notifications, service workflows, exports, and Google authentication.

caseStudy.problem: A banking interface must make account state, transfers, and financial actions easy to understand while keeping ledger behavior consistent.
caseStudy.role: Built the product flow and backend simulation across accounts, transfers, ledger records, savings, services, and authentication.
highlights: Account, transfer, beneficiary, and savings workflows
Demo-only environment with Google authentication and notifications
caseStudy.result: A safe banking environment for exploring realistic financial workflows without real money.

title: AI Study Hub
description: Full-stack academic workspace for organizing subjects, notes, documents, and learning materials with Markdown editing, autosave, file previews, AI-assisted Socratic chat, and study analytics.

caseStudy.problem: Students need a focused workspace that connects notes, documents, tasks, and guided AI assistance instead of scattering study work across separate tools.
caseStudy.role: Designed and built the academic workspace, synchronized study data, document flows, analytics, and AI-assisted learning interactions.
highlights: Subjects, notes, assignments, planner, and document workspace
Markdown editing, autosave, and PDF previews
Socratic AI assistant, quizzes, flashcards, and study analytics
caseStudy.result: A unified study environment that combines organization with guided, AI-assisted learning.

title: SAAD AI — Math Engine
description: AI-powered university-level mathematics solver built from scratch. Fine-tuned SmolLM2-1.7B on Kaggle GPU to solve calculus, algebra, real analysis, group theory and number theory with step-by-step academic explanations and LaTeX rendering.

caseStudy.problem: University-level mathematics often needs explanations that are structured, step-by-step, and readable in proper mathematical notation.
caseStudy.role: Trained and integrated a mathematics-focused language model, then built the reasoning interface and LaTeX presentation layer.
highlights: Fine-tuned SmolLM2-1.7B with LoRA and Unsloth
Coverage across calculus, algebra, analysis, group theory, and number theory
Step-by-step responses with rendered LaTeX explanations
caseStudy.result: A public mathematical reasoning prototype connecting model training, evaluation, and an accessible web interface.

title: Inkwell — Publishing Platform
description: Responsive blog and publishing platform with public posts, search and filtering, Markdown-style formatting, Supabase authentication, an admin panel, and post management workflows.

title: Premium E-Commerce Store
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform with React frontend and Node.js backend. Features JWT authentication, database-backed cart and wishlist, product filtering, dark mode, and smooth Framer Motion animations.

title: SUST GPA Calculator
description: GPA and grade tracker built specifically for SUST Mathematics students. Track courses, credits and grades semester by semester with automatic cumulative GPA calculation, progression charts, and Google cloud sync.

title: InvoicePro — SaaS Invoicing
description: Full-stack invoicing SaaS for freelancers and small businesses. Create, download, and track professional invoices with PDF export, status tracking (Draft/Sent/Paid), Google OAuth, and Row Level Security via Supabase.

title: AI Wealth Tracker
description: AI-powered personal finance dashboard. Track expenses, visualize spending with charts, get real-time financial advice from Gemini and Groq AI, export PDF and CSV reports, with full cloud sync via Firebase.

title: Ledger — Expense Tracker
description: Fast, mobile-friendly expense tracker with monthly budgets, daily spending charts, AI weekly summaries via Gemini, a smoking habit tracker with quit-motivation nudges, and PWA support for phone installation.

title: Discord GamingBot
description: Advanced Discord bot for gaming communities with XP leveling, auto role rewards at milestones, rank card image generation, economy system with daily coins, leaderboards, auto-moderation, and 12+ commands.
